data: Which function represents the lower bound for ψ?

The caption states that in orange (resp. blue), one can see the upper (resp. lower) bound given by Eq. (16). The question asks which function represents the lower bound for ψ. From the caption, we know that the blue line corresponds to the lower bound. Therefore, the blue line represents the lower bound for ψ.
